name: outside_body_profile_length
meaning: Outside longitudinal body-profile length reported by CAD (neck end to tail end).
notes: Cross-check target for the extracted-outline longitudinal extent (004L).

name: internal_headblock_tailblock_length
meaning: Internal body/cavity length from tail block to head block; also the extent of the Arnold side-height station axis (bottom station = 30.4375). NOT the developed rim length.
notes: Exact physical endpoints (head-block vs tail-block faces, and whether measured along the centerline or the internal cavity) are NOT uniquely fixed by the source; endpoint convention is PRESERVED AS UNRESOLVED. The value exceeds the outside body length (20.21875 in) and the developed one-side rim (004L), so it cannot be a straight neck-to-tail longitudinal span; it is retained as a labelled block-to-block / station-axis quantity, never equated to the other two lengths.

name: waist_radius
source: Arnold #65260 source annotation (4 7/16 in) + CAD confirmation
notes: A plan-geometry radius. NOT used to infer the longitudinal waist position (Decision 4); plan-view waist placement comes from outline geometry.

name: waist_side_height
meaning: Arnold measured side height at the waist (side-depth axis).
notes: A side-depth measurement. Dimensionally a length but on a different geometric axis than the waist radius; the two are unrelated (Decision 4).

name: developed_rim_length
meaning: Developed one-side rim distance (the side ribbon unrolled flat = one-side plan perimeter arc length). DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY in 004L; intentionally NULL here.
source: Independently derived from the extracted Arnold/JD plan contour (004L).
prior_interpretation: 004C/004D: proxied by 30.4375 in (the internal block-to-block value)
notes: Must NOT be inferred merely because a nearby dimension (30.4375 or 20.21875) exists on Arnold/GenOne; it is a distinct quantity requiring a geometric derivation (Decision 3).
